definitions.gloss: tea utensils; tea implements; tea ware
definitions.explanation: Tools and vessels used for preparing and serving tea, especially in the context of the Japanese tea ceremony. Includes items such as tea bowls, tea caddies, and whisks.

examples.japanese: {茶器|ちゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{茶器|ちゃき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This tea utensil is from the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名品|めいひん}→名品：19478_meihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茶器|ちゃき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦{愛好家|あいこうか}→愛好家：15008_aikouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Masterpiece tea utensils are on display at the museum, and they are popular with tea ceremony enthusiasts.

notes:
USAGE:
{茶器|ちゃき} can refer to any implements used for tea, but in Japanese it most often evokes the tea ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧). Historically, prized {茶器|ちゃき} were symbols of wealth and power among samurai and feudal lords.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶器|ちゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (to assemble a set of tea utensils)
- ⟦{名品|めいひん}→名品：19478_meihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茶器|ちゃき} (masterpiece tea ware)
- {茶器|ちゃき}⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧ (a full set of tea utensils)

CULTURAL NOTE:
During the Sengoku and Azuchi-Momoyama periods, famous {茶器|ちゃき} were valued as highly as land holdings and were exchanged as political gifts between warlords.
